title: Yield by catalyst and temperature
intro: A reaction was run with two catalysts (factor A, coded 1 and 2) at three temperatures (factor B: 160, 180 and 200 °C), three runs for every combination, and the yield measured (%). Every combination has the same number of runs, so the design is balanced. The interaction plot has the catalyst on the axis and one line per temperature: the 160 and 180 °C lines rise from catalyst 1 to 2, the 200 °C line falls, and the lines cross. Catalyst 2 gives the higher yield at 160 and 180 °C, catalyst 1 at 200 °C. The interaction is the largest effect.
